items.title: What’s next for the ISO net-zero standard
items.summary: If significant revisions are requested, an updated draft of the ISO net-zero framework must be circulated before a final approval vote can take place.

items.title: How the right language can convince skeptics to support corporate climate action
items.summary: Companies can expect consumer support for climate action — even from climate-skeptical Republicans — provided they talk about initiatives in the right way, according to a survey of 2,000 U.S. voters.

items.title: Why software firm Genesys will reset its emissions reduction baseline
items.summary: Genesys disclosed a year-over-year emissions reduction of 15 percent as part of its FY26 sustainability report, published Aug. 11.

items.title: What sustainability teams need to see coming
items.summary: Data center pushback. Energy-price shocks tied to the Iran war. A possible Super El Niño . A surging anti-oligarch , anti-tech-bro sentiment.

items.title: Could a Stern-style review on climate adaptation improve the UK’s economic resiliency?
items.summary: The Institution of Civil Engineers (ICE) has called on the UK Government to commission a review of the economic costs and opportunities of promoting climate adaptation, claiming it could have a similar impact of the Stern Review into climate change back in 2006.

items.title: How is Asia powering its data centre boom?
items.summary: As artificial intelligence (AI) workloads grow and data centre capacity rises, electricity demand across Asia is surging, but analysis has highlighted that countries are diverging in how they meet that demand.

items.title: How the oil endgame could become a macro risk for businesses
items.summary: A new report has found that global oil demand is approaching a plateau as electrification and efficiency gains spread from wealthy economies into China and beyond.

items.title: ON THURSDAY: Exploring the role of bio-based materials in lower-carbon buildings
items.summary: Next week, edie is hosting a new webinar exploring the growing interest in bio-based materials.

items.title: ONE WEEK to go until edie’s Sustainable Supply Chains Summit
items.summary: Join us on 17 September for a unique opportunity to gain expert-led insights through thought leadership and industry panels featuring top professionals in sustainability, supply chain and procurement.

items.title: Lidl GB commits £10m to expand EV charging across stores
items.summary: The retailer has announced that it is investing £10m this financial year to install 100 new rapid chargers across existing Lidl stores.
